facts.fact: Eyeota's audience marketplace is now available for request in the StackAdapt Third-Party Catalogue.
facts.quote: The Eyeota Audience Marketplace is now available directly for request in the StackAdapt Third-Party Catalogue.

facts.fact: Through the Eyeota partnership, StackAdapt platform users can target audiences across North America, APAC, EMEA regions.
facts.quote: This partnership gives StackAdapt platform users access to Eyeota’s global audience marketplace to enable precise targeting capabilities across North America, Asia-Pacific (APAC), Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA).

facts.fact: Eyeota states its audience solutions are privacy-compliant with GDPR and CCPA and independently certified for quality, per Eyeota's own claim.
facts.quote: Eyeota’s audience solutions are independently certified for quality, are privacy-compliant with GDPR and CCPA

facts.fact: Eyeota, per its own description, operates in 188 countries and was founded in 2010.
facts.quote: Founded in 2010, Eyeota operates in Europe, Asia, Australia and the Americas powering data solutions in 188 countries.

facts.quote: StackAdapt has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing technology companies in North America by Deloitte
